summary: Shared Data Sync (P0) tested and FIXED. Critical bug: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error on all POST /api/shared/* endpoints. Fixed by adding .pop('_id', None) before returning created documents. All 33 backend API tests now pass. Frontend sync verified working.

critical.issue: FIXED - MongoDB ObjectId not JSON serializable. Insert_one adds _id to document, causing 500 error when returning response. Fixed by adding artiste_doc.pop('_id', None) before return.

bug_fix_applied.issue: All POST /api/shared/* endpoints returning 500 Internal Server Error
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: MongoDB insert_one() modifies the input dict by adding _id field (ObjectId). FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId type.
bug_fix_applied.fix: Added .pop('_id', None) after insert_one() in all 7 POST endpoints: artistes, prestataires, tasks, partners, expenses, contacts, planning
